title: Ethics and Persuasion in Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback: A Procedural Rhetorical Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Procedural rhetorical analysis evaluating how the RLHF feedback loop assumes and enforces a normative 'baseline' or 'standard' for natural language, thereby obscuring other forms of expression and marginalizing diverse dialects.

Theoretical examination of how the demographic makeup, subjective instructions, and localized preferences of human annotators during the RLHF training process encode specific cultural perspectives and hegemonic values into language models.
